narration_fil: Pagkatapos ng pagbaha, hinihiling sa BHW na maglista ng sintomas at maghatid ng impormasyon sa response team. Hindi malinaw kung aktibo ang lumang BHERT roster.
narration_en: After flooding, a BHW is asked to record concerns and relay information to a response team. It is unclear whether an old BHERT roster is active.

narration_fil: Kumpirmahin sa barangay at health supervisor ang kasalukuyang team, tungkulin, lider at reporting channel. Iulat ang minimum na kailangan: lugar, panganib, agarang pangangailangan, ginawa at susunod na contact. Mag-handover at itala ang oras; panatilihing pribado ang sensitibong detalye.
narration_en: Confirm the current team, role, lead and reporting channel with the barangay and health supervisor. Report the minimum needed: location, hazard, urgent need, action taken and next contact. Hand over and record time; protect sensitive details.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang unang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the first safe step?

options.fil: Ipagpalagay na tama pa ang lumang impormasyon at agad itong ipasa sa lahat.
options.en: Assume the old information is still correct and immediately relay it to everyone.

options.fil: Kumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang lider at channel, saka mag-handover.
options.en: Confirm current lead and channel, then hand over.

options.fil: Magpasiya mag-isa nang walang lokal na kumpirmasyon o opisyal na babala.
options.en: Decide alone without local confirmation or an official warning.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring luma o mali ang impormasyon. 2: Ikinokonekta nito ang pagpapasya sa beripikadong plano at saklaw. 3: Kailangan ang tamang awtoridad at lokal na konteksto.
check.feedback_en: 1: Information may be old or wrong. 2: This ties action to a verified plan and scope. 3: The correct authority and local context are needed.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Suriin ang opisyal na plano.
Kumpirmahin ang lokal na contact.
display_en:
Check the official plan.
Confirm the local contact.
narration_fil: Hindi ipinagpalagay ng BHW na may aktibong BHERT. Kinumpirma niya ang kasalukuyang response focal person at ipinasa ang pangangailangan sa tamang channel.
narration_en: The BHW does not assume an active BHERT. They verify the current response focal person and hand the need over through the approved channel.

display_fil:
Huwag manghula.
Igalang ang tungkulin at privacy.
display_en:
Do not guess.
Respect role and privacy.
narration_fil: Ang lumang pandemic-era BHERT slide ay hindi patunay ng kasalukuyang team composition, isolation o contact-tracing mandate. Huwag magtalaga ng klinikal o enforcement na papel sa BHW.
narration_en: The old pandemic-era BHERT slide does not establish today’s team composition, isolation or contact-tracing mandate. Do not assign clinical or enforcement duties to a BHW.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Gamitin ang lumang roster at ipalagay ang dating mandato. Huwag nang tanungin ang awtoridad o ang taong apektado.
options.en: Use an old roster and assume its former mandate. Do not ask the authority or the affected person.

options.fil: Walang kailangang itala o balikan kahit hindi pa natatanggap ng tamang team.
options.en: Nothing needs recording or follow-up even without team acknowledgement.

options.fil: Ipaabot sa lead, itala ang handover, at balikan.
options.en: Inform the lead, record handover, and follow up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong. 2: Nawawala ang accountability at continuity. 3: Tinitiyak nito ang malinaw na pananagutan at susunod na aksiyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help. 2: Accountability and continuity are lost. 3: This establishes clear ownership and next action.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

Record date and follow-up.
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipa-update sa supervisor ang role-and-handover card: pangalan ng posisyon, alternatibong contact, channel at petsa ng kumpirmasyon.
narration_en: On Monday, ask the supervisor to update a role-and-handover card: position, backup contact, channel and verification date.
